descriptionChirho: To deny the truth, lie, deceive, or deal falsely with someone, often in the context of covenant unfaithfulness or bearing false witness (Piel).
To cringe before, cower, or feign obedience and submission to a conqueror or superior, implying insincerity (Piel/Hitpael/Nifal of defeated enemies).
To fail, prove deceptive, or disappoint expectations, said of things such as harvests, streams, or strength that do not deliver what was hoped for (Piel).
To become thin, emaciated, or wasted in body, referring to physical deterioration (Qal).
